props.description: AI agents that transact onchain — agent payments, AI-judged bounties, decentralized AI oracles — 2026-08-24

props.text: Solana flipped x402's chain-dominance numbers this week while Virtuals Protocol opened fractional AI-agent ownership to Solana users the same day — thin on hard infra news otherwise.

props.title: Solana overtakes Base as x402's dominant chain — 3.3M USDC agent payments in one week

props.text: AI agents moved 3.3M USDC over x402 on Solana in the week to Aug 24 — 65% of the prior 90 days' cumulative total (5.1M transfers) — per Token Terminal data reported by CryptoBriefing and mirrored on CoinDesk. Solana now handles roughly 70% of x402's monthly volume; typical transaction is under $0.50.
This reverses the chain-dominance read from the last tracked figure (Base led as of Aug 18's 14M/30-day stat) — a real shift in where agent-payment infra is concentrating, not just volume growth.

props.title: Virtuals Protocol opens fractional AI-agent ownership to Solana users

props.text: Virtuals Protocol launched Solana support (Aug 24) letting users hold token stakes in autonomous on-chain agents that trade and share revenue — 70% to creators, 30% to treasury — via its Agent Commerce Protocol. 28,212 VIRTUAL holders on Solana and a $17.3M market cap as of Aug 23.
This is a bet on tokenized ownership of agent economic activity itself, distinct from payment-rail plumbing — a different growth vector than the infra stories this digest usually tracks.

Thin day — only 2 items cleared the bar. X signal (10 posts) was mostly promo/ambassador content (Concordium, 1inch, Binance recaps); a Polymarket/UMA oracle lawsuit over a mis-resolved Bitcoin-sale market is directly relevant to Verdikta's dispute-layer thesis but the filing (Jul 3) and vote (Jun 4) are both weeks stale, so it's held back per the freshness rule.
